result.description:
Position: Project Administrator
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $85,000  - $90,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: OPTIMO WATERPROOFING GROUP PTY LTD - T/a OPTIMO WATERPROOFING
A.B.N. 47 677 710 879
Job Location: Unit 12, 6 Alexander Street, Auburn, NSW, 2144,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 3 Jul 2026 > 31 Jul 2026

Please include Reference: J1674-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client Optimo Waterproofing Group Pty Ltd is a trusted Sydney-based waterproofing specialist delivering residential, commercial and remedial solutions across NSW, QLD and ACT. 

Our client is seeking to add Project Administrator support to coordinate project documentation, contractor communications and compliance processes, helping maintain high-quality workmanship, Australian Standards alignment and dependable client service across diverse waterproofing projects.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Coordinate project administration for residential, commercial, strata and remedial waterproofing works.
- Maintain accurate project files, contracts, purchase orders and site documentation.
- Support Project Managers with schedules, milestones, variations and progress tracking.
- Liaise with clients, contractors, suppliers, architects and site personnel regarding project matters.
- Prepare, review and distribute project reports, submissions, correspondence and meeting notes.
- Respond to enquiries and resolve administrative issues relating to project delivery.
- Monitor contractor paperwork, work orders, compliance records and variation requests.
- Collect and organise project data to support reporting on outcomes and performance.
- Assist with procurement coordination for membranes, materials, equipment and subcontractor services.
- Track approvals, warranties, inspection records and documentation required under Australian Standards.
- Escalate matters requiring management attention and help implement approved decisions.
- Support tender, quotation and contract administration for waterproofing projects.
- Coordinate communication between office staff and site teams to maintain workflow continuity.
- Maintain professional client relationships through timely updates and accurate administrative support.
- Assist with administrative improvements that strengthen project control and service consistency.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Minimum 12 months’ experience in a Project Administrator, Project Coordinator, Contract Administrator or similar construction support role.
- Certificate III or Certificate IV in Business Administration, Project Administration, Building and Construction, or a related field is highly regarded.
- Experience supporting construction, waterproofing, remedial works, trade services or subcontractor coordination is strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to manage project documentation, work orders, variations, reports, correspondence and compliance records accurately.
- Experience liaising with Project Managers, contractors, suppliers, clients, architects, engineers and site-based personnel.
- Strong organisational, communication and computer skills, including Microsoft Office and project or document management systems.
- Understanding of Australian construction requirements, workplace safety obligations and quality documentation processes is preferred.
- Practical knowledge of waterproofing systems, including sheet membranes, concrete additives, vapour barriers and below-ground applications, is essential.

Please include Reference: J1674-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.
